about: Captions and proposed times (Central) for the three hauntings Shorts, Oct. 21, 2026. Nothing posts without Scoop's OK. Each Short points to the full documentary (https://youtu.be/p9_gDkDVAPs). The pictures are real: public domain, or CC BY (no share-alike), and every CC BY photographer is credited on screen and in each post (YouTube gets the license links). Buffer channels: YouTube (LaPorteWeatherNow), TikTok (scoopanddude), X (ScoopAndDude).

posts.youtube_title: The lighthouse keeper who never left? Michigan City, Indiana
posts.youtube:
For 43 years, Harriet Colfax lit the lamp in Michigan City's lighthouse. "I could not bear to see anyone else light my lamp." Some say she's still keeping watch. 🕯️ The Old Lighthouse Museum is open Wed.-Sun., 1-4 p.m., through Oct. 31.

Watch the full documentary: https://youtu.be/p9_gDkDVAPs

#MichiganCity #Indiana #Lighthouse #History #Halloween

Pictures: postcards of Michigan City, 1910, 1911 and 1933, Steve Shook via Wikimedia Commons, CC BY 2.0 (creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.0); Michigan City's lights, 1917, U.S. Lighthouse Service, National Archives (public domain); the old lighthouse today, Jjegers at English Wikipedia, CC BY 2.5 (creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.5).

posts.youtube_title: A headless ghost flagging trains? La Porte, Indiana, 1905
posts.youtube:
In 1905, newspapers said a headless ghost was flagging trains near La Porte, Indiana. People said it was Columbus Cole, but even the papers couldn't agree on how he died. 👻

Watch the full documentary: https://youtu.be/p9_gDkDVAPs

#LaPorte #Indiana #Haunted #GhostStory #History #Halloween

Pictures: newspapers of 1905, from the Library of Congress, and a locomotive, 1909 (public domain); the documentary's thumbnail, a 1933 postcard, Steve Shook via Wikimedia Commons, CC BY 2.0 (creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.0).

posts.youtube_title: The skeptic who lit up a séance: La Porte, Indiana, 1850s
posts.youtube:
In the 1850s, a former congressman from La Porte, Indiana, went to a spirit circle to expose it, armed with a homemade "lightning bug." What he saw made him a believer. 🥁

Watch the full documentary: https://youtu.be/p9_gDkDVAPs

#LaPorte #Indiana #Spiritualism #History #Halloween

Pictures: séance photos, 1909, Bain News Service, Library of Congress (public domain); Emma Hardinge's Modern American Spiritualism (1870) and The Spiritualist Register for 1859 (public domain); the documentary's thumbnail, a 1933 postcard, Steve Shook via Wikimedia Commons, CC BY 2.0 (creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.0).
